principles: Read findings only through the stable store.readFindings port
Inert foundation: derive now, wire later
Conservative, explainable signalScore with support always shown
drivers: Must not pollute gate material hashing
Must not couple to findings.json on-disk format
Must keep the module independently testable and isolated

options.name: separate-modules-zero-outward-imports
pros: Matches the usage-ledger isolation bar (zero outward imports)
finding-signals reads via store.readFindings port, decoupled from on-disk format
Derived cache excluded from gates by one registry entry
cons: Three new files for a small slice
Signal richness limited until Phase 1b adds signatureTag

options.name: single-file-in-existing-core
cons: Couples learning logic to existing core; harder to evolve and gate-safe-test

rationale: Mirrors the proven usage-ledger isolation; the store-port read and the single registry exclude entry are the two load-bearing decoupling/gate-safety choices the execution plan mandates.

preMortem.scenario: Derived cache pollutes gate material hash
preMortem.mitigation: CHK-003 registers the path; the smoke asserts currentMaterialHash unchanged after write

preMortem.scenario: finding-signals couples to findings.json on-disk format
preMortem.trigger: Parsing findings.json directly instead of store.readFindings
preMortem.consequence: Silent breakage when finding storage changes; violates isolation
preMortem.mitigation: Read only via store.readFindings; smoke + reviewer verify the accessor is used

preMortem.scenario: Module imports leak outward into existing core
preMortem.mitigation: Smoke statically asserts zero ../../ imports out of the module

preMortem.scenario: signalScore divides by zero or mis-ranks on tiny samples
preMortem.mitigation: signalScore = positive/(positive+negative+1); always show support; smoke covers zero-sample and single-hit cases
